B1_replacement.claim_to_drop: English is the easiest target (round02 L217-218).

corpus_composition_caveat: Directional asymmetry partly reflects corpus language composition (en 46% / zh 0.4% of documents), not only encoder behaviour: the hub score correlates with how many target-language documents exist to find.
writer_replacement_sentence: the hardest direction is en->de (R@10 0.12) and the most asymmetric pair is de<->zh (gap +0.23); no single language is a clean 'easiest target' (fr 0.375 ~ en 0.367), and what asymmetry exists partly tracks corpus composition.
